na.reason: Xbox Live service layer (sign-in, friends, invitations, matchmaking, leaderboards, content download, mute lists) and the two accessors that return it. On PC the same class fronted the Ubi.com game service, which no longer runs. Xbox Live is not a target; the rewrite finds games through its own master server and LAN discovery.
Xbox Live error pages of the menu ("Your Xbox console cannot connect to Xbox Live", duplicate sign-in). Xbox only: no script opens them on PC.
PlayStation 2 natives: network configuration (NetCnf, NetCtl), DNAS authentication, memory card port check and online/offline switches. PS2 only.
Platform queries. The rewrite is a PC game, so ports take the PC branch of their callers directly (IsPsx2 and IsXbox false, IsPC true) instead of asking.
Console save storage: memory card state and the Xbox dashboard's memory page. PC profiles are files on disk; the PC callers only use these as no-ops.

The stock engine's console rumble natives. No script calls them in this build: the Enhanced 4.0 scripts drive rumble through the Reloaded natives NativeRumble* (1910 to 1915), which stay in scope (spec/reloaded/FEATURES.md rl:input.rumble, spec/native/reloaded-hooks.md rule 28).
Commandlets: command-line and editor tools (ucc), never run by the game.
Reloaded's client verification challenge (server request, client reply computed by a Reloaded native, server discards it). spec/native/reloaded-hooks.md rule 27: the rewrite does not reproduce it.
